mutations.name: commit-sweeps-the-whole-tree
mutations._mechanism: The commit is no longer pathspec-scoped, so an unrelated dirty tracked file rides along (gap 1).

mutations.name: claim-check-disabled
mutations._mechanism: A path declared by another open cycle is committed anyway (gap 1).

mutations.name: unchanged-path-not-refused
mutations._mechanism: An unchanged declared path no longer refuses, so an empty or partial commit is made.

mutations.name: no-documents-still-runs-consumers
mutations._mechanism: With no changed documents the consumers --run is invoked anyway, whose UNREADABLE no-documents was read as a result (gap 3).

mutations.name: consumers-failure-ignored
mutations._mechanism: A non-zero consumers verdict is folded into success and land proceeds to the census (gap 3).

mutations.name: pipe-not-escaped
mutations._mechanism: A | in the status splits the table cell and the census refuses the row.

mutations.name: ambiguous-row-accepted
mutations._mechanism: A row name matching two open rows is accepted instead of refused.

mutations.name: push-forced
mutations._mechanism: A forced push overwrites a remote that moved ahead.

mutations.name: no-push-ignored
mutations._mechanism: --no-push still pushes.

mutations.name: dirty-store-not-refused
mutations._mechanism: Unrelated store edits ride along in the LANDED commit.

mutations.name: store-restored-from-index
mutations._mechanism: The restore reads the index, which already holds the staged edit, so the row stays closed but uncommitted.

mutations.name: deleted-files-kept
mutations._mechanism: A document the cycle deleted is handed to consumers, which refuse it as missing on every retry.
mutations.find: return sorted(rel for rel in files if (repo / rel).exists())

mutations.name: missing-commit-not-named
mutations._mechanism: A vanished recorded commit is not refused by name.

mutations.name: red-only-cycle-lands
mutations._mechanism: A cycle with no GREEN commit is closed as LANDED.

mutations.name: paths-read-from-repo-root
mutations._mechanism: --paths typed relative to a subdirectory resolve against the repo root and name the wrong file.

mutations.name: paths-follow-symlinks
mutations._mechanism: Calling .resolve() on the --paths entry dereferences a symlink inside the repo to its target path.

mutations.name: record-missing-commits-keyerror
mutations._mechanism: Without defaulting missing record keys in load(), a record without 'commits' raises KeyError.

mutations.name: concurrent-store-edit-clobbered-on-commit-failure
mutations._mechanism: Unconditionally running git checkout HEAD -- store_rel on commit failure discards a concurrent edit made after the dirty check.
mutations.find: if before_apply == head_bytes and args.store.read_bytes() == stamped:

mutations.name: git-failed-omits-path
mutations._mechanism: Omitting the path suffix after '--' leaves git-failed without the path that failed.
mutations.find: suffix = f" path={','.join(tail)}" if tail else ""

mutations.name: table-cell-omits-padding-before-closing-pipe
mutations._mechanism: Without a space before the closing pipe, a status ending in a backslash escapes the closing pipe and breaks the table cell.
